text:
Alex: quick question — in /v1/outputs we're adding a new top-level `chargeable_units` field to simplify billing. Does everyone agree on semantics? It should be: prompt_tokens + completion_tokens - cached_tokens (cached tokens are free). Also should be absent for legacy models that don't report cached_tokens.
Maya: fyi this affects invoice reconciliation. If field absent we fallback to sum of prompt+completion, but that will double-charge if cached_tokens exist but model didn't report them.
Sam: can we add a `cache_reported: true|false` flag instead? easier for downstream accounting.
Jordan: prefer keeping surface area small. If model can report `cached_tokens` include them; if not, keep `chargeable_units` absent. Accounting should detect and use `chargeable_units` when present. Backup heuristic: if response contains `cached_tokens` but no `chargeable_units`, compute it.
Alex: that sounds ok. Proposed contract (examples):
```json
{
  "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 120, "completion_tokens": 30, "cached_tokens": 10, "chargeable_units": 140}
}
```
Note: chargeable_units = 120+30-10 = 140. If cached_tokens missing and chargeable_units missing, billing sums prompt+completion.
Maya: small edgecase: streaming responses — we aggregate partial usage per chunk. Need to ensure chargeable_units is emitted on final event only. Add note in spec.
Sam: +1. Also add that chargeable_units must be an integer >=0. No negative allowed (in case of cache > total).
BillingBot: reminder — billing pipeline currently trusts `chargeable_units` when present, else falls back to prompt+completion. Rule: if `chargeable_units` < (prompt+completion - cached) or inconsistent, flag for review.
Jordan: for backward-compat, add schema version header? e.g., `usage_schema_version: "v1"` in response. Then we can evolve semantics w/out ambiguity.
Alex: ok i'll update the openapi PR and add tests: unit tests for legacy model (no cached_tokens), model with cached_tokens but no chargeable_units (compute on ingest), and model with chargeable_units present (use it). pinging @Maya @Sam for quick review.
Maya: will review today :+1:
Sam: will do a quick pass this afternoon.
Alex: thanks — if no objections i'll merge by EOD and trigger a migration job for accounting.
